Title: SSAS Developer 
 Location: Minneapolis, MN 
 Duration: 6+ Months 
 
 Required Skills: 
 SSAS
 Cubes
 MDX
 OLAP 
 Job Description: 
 This developer will be joining EDABI team. This team is building a portal that will house various functions for EDABI team at Target. This portal will link roughly 250-300 weekly users. The project has been underway and has already had a few releases. This developer will work with complex SSAS to design the project from end to end. SSAS Developer will join team to maintain an enterprise level data warehouse cube. Developer will be responsible for assisting with the development of logical and physical Cubes and Dimensions and participate in test plan creation and the testing process. Developer will also accurately estimate the size of the development effort as measured and provide complete documentation in the form of commented code, problem status information, and design documents. They will perform thorough unit testing as required to provide a quality product and thorough problem analysis that results in resolution of problems according to standards. Other responsibilities will include:
 Complete code and other deliverables on schedule
 Use Source Control (i.e. SourceSafe) to manage project versions and code changes
 Implement and enforce companywide coding standards and best practices provided
 Work in an agile development life cycle approach
 Support analysis services database administration tasks during development and post go live
 Follow release management, build process and versioning within a source control environment
 Build migration development within environments following deployment best practices
 Work under minimum supervision, team member, task/goal oriented.
 100% SSAS
 SSAS Security using data driven approach
 SSAS Dimension Usage design - Many to Many advantages & pitfalls
 SSAS Backup & Restore scenarios
 SSAS Error handling
 SSAS Troubleshooting Exploring SSAS Time Intelligence features
 

 If you are interested in the below position please forward your profile to preethib @usmsystems(dot)com or call me on  703 468 0398
